text:
jamie-sre: apiserver 503s spiking in southamerica1 since 11:03 UTC, controller-manager leader election flapping. seeing lots of pods stuck Terminating in gpu-nodepools. anyone oncall?
oncall-bot: ALERT: apiserver_503_rate > 6% (southamerica1) — https://mon.redwood.example/alerts/10011 :rotating_light:
nora-runtime: checking etcd metrics — apply latency jumped to ~1.5s and leader raft heartbeats missed around 11:02. watchers reconnecting.
ben-provisioner: autoscaler reports ~58 pending GPU pods, many with finalizer wait. paused scale actions to avoid churn. cost risk if we force reprovision.
kai-net: we pushed a maintenance BGP tweak to edge peers at 11:00 to reroute some traffic for a peering optimization test. vendor telemetry shows transient ARP storms on two ToR switches starting 11:01-11:04. rolling back now.
jamie-sre: logs: ```
E0310 11:03:07.234 1 handler.go:200] rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed
W0310 11:03:07.235 1 watch.go:99] watch closed: socket abort
etcdserver: apply entries took too long: 1500ms
```
nora-runtime: quick action: increase etcd client dial timeout to 12s and extend controller-manager lease renew to reduce flapping while rollback completes. applying via kube-system patch.
ben-provisioner: paused autoscaling, adding note: estimated incremental cost if naive reprovision ~ $7.4k/day.
kai-net: BGP rollback submitted, removing the peering test route. creating NET-2033 for vendor follow-up and ToR stability gating.
nora-runtime: after dial timeout bump, watchers stabilize and apiserver 503 rate trending down to 1.8%.
jamie-sre: good. action items: (1) keep autoscaler paused for 30m, (2) schedule postmortem if SLA blip >5m, (3) update runbook to include upstream BGP/ARP checks.
ben-provisioner: will also add circuit-breaker in provisioner to detect apiserver 50x and backoff scale attempts. filing PR.
kai-net: will request vendor rollback verification and add preflight ARP test to firmware/peer pushes.
nora-runtime: opened PR to document etcd timeout rationale. will revert the transient config once stable.
jamie-sre: thanks all — monitoring for 1h. react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT LOGGED: INC-2026-078 severity P2.
